sleeping_bag.name: Classic Sleeping Bag 20F (-7C)

sleeping_bag.chamber_construction: vertical upper-body baffles with no sewn-through seams
sleeping_bag.key_features: 20F/-7C Standard-Medium normalized row; 533 g total; 388 g of 900 FP duck down; hoodless design; 3/4 zipper; 30% overstuff; can vent and function as a hybrid between bag and quilt.

sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Extra overstuff, no sewn-through seams, roomy footbox and strong versatility for venting or side sleeping.
sleeping_bag.use_cases: Ultralight backpacking for users who already sleep in a hooded jacket or down hood system.
sleeping_bag.customization_options: multiple widths, lengths and shell/liner colors
